description: Know when it’s time to go #selflove #selfcare #accountability
transcript: I never stay anywhere longer than necessary because I'm always willing to reinvent my life. I am always willing to find another route. I am always willing to come up with another plan. And that allows me to take control of my nervous system. I don't allow anything to impact my peace. I don't allow anything to take the fullest version of me away from myself. I will always chase peace. I will always chase my happiness. I'm not doing this for anyone else. I am doing this for myself. And I am the most important person in my life.
